page_no_similar: No note is close to this one.
page_empty_day: Nothing captured. Press {hotkey} to write a note.
page_delete_description: It is removed from its day file. There is no undo.
capture_hint: Ctrl+Enter to save, Ctrl+Shift+Enter for a page, Esc to dismiss
capture_space_title: The space the note goes into. {first} to {last} pick one.
update_hint: {version} is out; you have {current}. Updating restarts Scratchnote.
onboarding_language_body: Scratchnote follows this language. You can change it later in Settings.
onboarding_welcome_body: A scratchpad for the thoughts that come up in the middle of a task. Jot one down, get back to work, and find it again later.
onboarding_local_body: Your notes, search and everything else run here: no account, no cloud, no tracking. Nothing you write ever leaves this machine. The only thing Scratchnote downloads is its search model, once, when you ask for it.
onboarding_feature_capture_body: A shortcut opens a small window over whatever you are doing. Type, save, and it is out of the way.
onboarding_feature_search_body: Search by word or by meaning, and open the notes closest to the one you are reading.
onboarding_feature_threads_body: Notes about the same thing are gathered into a thread, however far apart you wrote them.
onboarding_feature_spaces_body: Work, side projects, personal: each space has its own notes, in its own folder.
onboarding_folder_body: Each space gets its own folder in here, with one markdown file per day that any editor can open. The search model is kept here too, and nothing is synced anywhere.
onboarding_folder_restart: Scratchnote restarts to use this folder, then picks up where you left off.
onboarding_hotkey_body: Press it from any app to open the capture window. To change it, click the field and press a new combination.
onboarding_hotkey_try: Try it now: the capture window opens over this one.
onboarding_model_body: It finds notes by meaning: similar notes, threads and search by meaning. It runs entirely on this computer, so your notes never leave it, and it is downloaded once ({size}).
onboarding_appearance_body: Pick a theme, an accent and a font. Every choice applies at once, and Settings has them all later.
note_edit_hint: Ctrl+Enter to save, Esc to cancel
thread_rename_description: Leave it empty to go back to no title.
thread_gone: This thread is gone: its notes no longer go together.
threads_suggested_hint: Notes that look like one thing. Keep a thread to have new notes join it, or dismiss it.
threads_none: No threads yet: notes about one thing gather here as you write.
map_empty: The map appears once your notes are embedded: notes about the same thing sit close together.
thread_suggested_banner: Suggested: these notes look like one thing.
thread_pick_add_hint: The threads it fits best come first. It stays in the one you pick.
thread_pick_move_hint: The notes stay in the thread you pick.
thread_pick_merge_hint: Every note of this thread moves to the one you pick.
editor_empty: A note cannot be empty. Delete it instead.
spaces_trash_hint: Its folder is moved to {trash}. Move it back under {spaces} to restore it.
settings_general_description: The app's version and updates, where your notes live and how you capture them.
settings_root_hint: One markdown file per day lives here.
settings_root_dialog: Choose where to store your notes
settings_restart_needed: Saved. Restart Scratchnote to switch from {path}.
settings_hotkey_hint: Opens the capture window from anywhere.
settings_hide_on: The capture window closes as soon as a note is saved.
settings_hide_off: The capture window shows "Saved" for a second first.
settings_login_hint: Start Scratchnote when you sign in.
settings_onboarding_hint: Go through the first-run setup again: language, folder, shortcut, search model and appearance.
settings_appearance_description: Language, colors and sizes. Changes apply right away.
settings_font_hint: The typeface of the interface and your notes.
settings_text_size_hint: Scales the whole interface, notes included.
settings_radius_hint: How rounded cards, buttons and inputs are.
settings_embedding_hint: Finds notes by meaning: similar notes, threads and search by meaning.
settings_index_description: The search index is only a cache of your markdown files. Each space has its own; these act on the open one.
settings_startup_description: How long this window took to open, from when it began loading until its first view was up. The first view waits for the plugins to load.
settings_rebuild_hint: Reparse every daily file, clean out the labels older versions wrote in the notes, and redo search by meaning from scratch. Always safe to run.

match.countPlural=one: Index rebuilt from the markdown: {count} note.
match.countPlural=other: Index rebuilt from the markdown: {count} notes.

pages_none: No pages in this space yet.
pages_missing: Page not found. Its file may have been moved or deleted, or not synced yet.
pages_body_placeholder: Write here. It saves as you type.
pages_needs_title: Add a title to save this page.
pages_turn_into_description: The note gets a file of its own and shows on its day as a page.
move_description: It leaves {space} for the space picked and keeps its day and its attachments.
pages_delete_description: Its file is deleted and it leaves its day. There is no undo.
pages_remove_stub_description: Only its link leaves the day. If its file turns up, the page comes back.
tasks_none: No open tasks. Start a line with - [ ] in a note or a page to add one.
settings_core_plugins_description: Features that ship with the app. Switch on the ones you want, off the ones you do not use.
settings_community_plugins_description: Features written by other people, added from the community list.
plugins_community_hint: Plugins written by other people. While this is off, none of their code runs.
plugins_browse_hint: Find plugins in the community list and install them.
plugins_updates_none: Every plugin is up to date.
plugins_installed_none: No community plugin is installed. Browse the list to find one.
plugins_uninstall_description: Its files and its settings are removed from the notes folder.
plugins_trust_description: A community plugin is code written by someone else, and it runs with the app's own access: it can read and change your notes, reach the internet, and run programs on this computer. Only install plugins whose authors you trust.
plugins_page_missing: This page belongs to a plugin that is switched off.
plugins_error_no_class: main.js does not export a Plugin class.
plugins_error_core_id: Has the id of a core plugin
tasks_description: Boxes to tick in notes and pages, the checklist button, and every open task on one page.
tasks_setting_ribbon_hint: Opens the open tasks, from any view.
tasks_setting_order_hint: Which tasks the list starts with.
basics_plugin_description: Tasks to tick and text to highlight, each with its own switch in the settings.
highlights_description: Text between ==double equals== on a band of color, from the toolbar or with Ctrl+Shift+H.
highlights_setting_color_hint: What highlighted text is painted with.
mentions_plugin_description: Write @name to mention someone. A click on a mention lists every note that names them.
mentions_none: No mentions yet. Write @name in a note.
stats_plugin_description: A panel beside the day with how much the space holds, your writing streak, and a heatmap of the days you wrote.
stats_setting_weeks_hint: How far back the heatmap goes.
journal_plugin_description: Your days as a journal book. Turn the pages from one day to the next, with the pictures of your notes taped in.
journal_empty: Nothing written yet. Your notes will fill these pages.
